description: This file defines the TimesheetActionLog class, an entity representing logs of actions performed on timesheets within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties for action details, timestamps, associated user and timesheet, and uses Doctrine ORM for database mapping.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLog
classes.description: Entity class representing a log entry for actions performed on a timesheet, with ORM mappings and associated getter/setter methods.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the log entry.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the optional comment associated with the log.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets the optional comment for the log.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Retrieves the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time for the log entry.

methods.name: getPerformedUser
methods.description: Gets the user who performed the action, if available.

methods.name: setPerformedUser
methods.description: Sets the user who performed the action.

methods.name: setTimesheet
methods.description: Associates a timesheet with this log entry.
